when.quote: Every Rho-Bank credit card earns rewards on all purchases, but certain categories of spending may earn you bonus rewards at a higher rate.

starts.note: customer: start only when the customer asks one of these: which personal card suits them, for a card that meets stated requirements, which card has the best sign-up or promotional bonus, or to apply (including for a specific card they name). The agent compares the cards and recommends. For a card the customer names, it checks that card's entry requirement. The customer applies with their own apply_for_credit_card tool. No document tells the agent to offer a card unprompted.
starts.quote: Complete the application in your Rho‑Bank dashboard and consent to a credit pull (minimum score: $720).

tools.not_used: Not used for a product recommendation. The policy requires verification only when the agent reads or changes customer records, and a recommendation does neither. Verify (2 of DOB, email, phone, address, then log_verification) only if the customer also asks about their own accounts.
Not used, for the same reason as get_user_information_by_name. A recommendation reads no customer records.
Not used, for the same reason as get_user_information_by_name. A recommendation reads no customer records.
Used only after a verification that is actually needed (see above). A recommendation alone does not need one.
This tool only changes an existing card to a no-annual-fee card. It cannot open a new card, so this job does not use it.
The agent can explain every card itself, and the customer applies themselves. Transfer only under policy guideline 6, after the customer has asked 4 times.

info.about: Whether the card is for personal or business spending. This decides whether personal or business cards are candidates.
info.ask: Is this card for your personal everyday spending or for a business?

info.about: The same fact as card_use (personal everyday purchases or a business), kept from the earlier version. Business cards are judged on business credit.
info.ask: Is this card for your personal everyday purchases or for a business?

info.about: The same fact as card_use, kept from the merged recommend_and_apply version. This workflow covers personal cards; business cards need business credit (PAYDEX).
info.ask: Is this card for personal use or for a business?

info.about: Where the customer's spending goes (everyday purchases, travel, software, green merchants) and whether another card already covers any of it, for example a corporate card that pays for work travel.
info.ask: What do you mainly plan to use the card for? Are any categories, like travel, already paid by another card such as an employer card?

info.about: The highest foreign transaction fee the customer will accept, if they have a ceiling
info.ask: What is the highest foreign transaction fee you would accept?

info.about: The highest minimum monthly payment percentage the customer will accept, if they have a ceiling
info.ask: What is the highest minimum monthly payment, as a percent of your balance, that works for you?

info.about: Whether the card must offer virtual card management
info.ask: Do you need virtual card management on the card?

info.about: Any other hard requirements, such as annual fee, rewards or APR
info.ask: Is there anything else the card must have, such as no annual fee or a certain kind of rewards?

info.about: Whether the customer will accept a card with an annual fee at all, or only if it is the only option.
info.ask: Would you consider a card with an annual fee, or do you want a card with no annual fee?

info.about: The most the customer will pay each year in fees after any rebate. Use this when the customer gives a dollar budget rather than a yes or no.
info.ask: What is the most you're willing to pay each year in card fees?

info.about: How much the customer expects to put on the card each month. This decides whether the Platinum $150.00 annual fee rebate applies ($7500.00 in every monthly window).
info.ask: About how much do you expect to spend on the card each month?

info.about: Whether the customer has an active Rho-Bank+ subscription from any source (for example, given through an employer). The Gold Rewards Card requires one, and it also changes the Silver card's foreign transaction fee.
info.ask: Do you currently have an active Rho-Bank+ premium subscription?

info.about: The same fact as rho_bank_plus_subscription, kept from the earlier version. The application tool asks for it.
info.ask: Do you have an active Rho-Bank+ subscription?

info.about: The same fact as rho_bank_plus_subscription, kept from the merged credit_card_application version. It is the application tool's argument.
info.ask: Do you have a Rho-Bank+ subscription?

info.about: The customer's approximate credit score, checked against each card's minimum. No agent tool reads it. The customer may not know it or may decline to say.
info.ask: Roughly what is your current credit score?

info.about: Whether the customer has received a Diamond Elite Card invitation.
info.ask: Have you received an invitation from Rho-Bank for the Diamond Elite Card?

info.about: The customer's annual income, which the customer's apply_for_credit_card tool asks for.
info.ask: What is your annual income?

info.about: The customer's full name for the application.
info.ask: What is your full name?

info.about: The specific personal card the customer says they want to apply for, when they name one instead of asking for a recommendation
info.ask: Which card would you like to apply for?

info.about: Whether the customer's main goal is a new-customer sign-up bonus in points, cash back or a statement credit. A 0% intro APR, a first-year fee waiver or a temporary cash back multiplier is not a sign-up bonus.
info.ask: Is your main goal a sign-up bonus in points or cash back, or another kind of promotion, such as an intro APR or an annual fee waiver?

info.about: How to choose when more than one card has an open sign-up bonus, for example the lowest annual fee or the largest bonus
info.ask: If more than one card has a sign-up bonus, what matters most to you: the lowest annual fee, the biggest bonus, or something else?

steps.do: Greet the customer. Confirm they want a personal card recommendation, for example the card with the highest cash back or a card that meets specific requirements. Do not verify identity: no customer records are read or changed.
steps.quote: You earn 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases.

steps.do: Before recommending anything, collect the customer's hard requirements (foreign transaction fee ceiling, minimum payment ceiling, virtual card management, any others), their credit score, their Rho-Bank+ subscription status, and whether the card is for personal or business use. No identity verification is needed, because no customer records are read or changed.
steps.quote: You must provide standard identity and income information during the application.

steps.do: Before comparing cards, ask for each of these the customer has not given: personal or business use; main spending categories, and any that another card already covers; whether they will accept an annual fee. Do not verify identity, because no customer records are read.
steps.quote: Each credit card has its own bonus categories with higher reward rates.

steps.do: Before recommending anything, ask for the yearly fee budget and the expected monthly spend. These decide whether the Platinum rebate makes its fee acceptable.
steps.if: the customer may accept an annual fee and has not already given a fee budget and monthly spend
steps.quote: Earn a $150.00 rebate on your annual fee by meeting a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00.

steps.do: Before recommending, ask three things: whether the customer has an active Rho-Bank+ subscription, their approximate credit score, and whether they hold a Diamond Elite invitation. Customers often do not volunteer these facts.
steps.if: the customer has not already said these
steps.quote: Rho‑Bank+ premium subscription required: Yes

steps.do: Call get_current_time to see which promotion windows are open, such as the Platinum first-year fee waiver (2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31) or the Bronze 0% APR window (2025-09-01 through 2026-02-28). Mention only promotions whose window includes today.
steps.if: a fee-waiver promotion would affect the comparison, or the agent intends to mention any promotion
steps.quote: Apply during the promo window and, if approved, your first year annual fee is $0.00 instead of $200.00.

steps.do: Read every personal card's own documents for minimum credit score, subscription or invitation requirement, foreign transaction fee, minimum payment, virtual card management and annual fee. Bronze Rewards: _001, _005. Silver Rewards: _001, _007. Gold Rewards: _001, _005. Platinum Rewards: _001. Diamond Elite: _001, _002, _005, _008. EcoCard: _001, _008. Crypto-Cash Back: _001, _008, _009. Never judge from one card's page.

steps.quote: Minimum credit score required to apply: 0 (0 indicates no credit score requirement).

steps.do: Check the Bronze Rewards Card: FX fee 2.75%, minimum payment 1.0%, virtual card management No, minimum credit score 640
steps.quote: Foreign transaction fee on international purchases: 2.75%

steps.do: Check the Silver Rewards Card: FX fee 2.75% without a premium subscription (0% with one), minimum payment 1.5% of statement balance, virtual card management No, minimum credit score 680
steps.quote: Virtual card management features are No for this card

steps.do: Check the Gold Rewards Card: FX fee 0%, minimum payment 2.0%, virtual card management Yes, minimum credit score 720, Rho-Bank+ subscription required
steps.quote: Minimum payment due each cycle: 2.0% of your outstanding balance

steps.do: Check the Platinum Rewards Card: FX fee 0%, minimum payment 2.5%, virtual card management Yes, annual fee $200.00, minimum credit score 750
steps.quote: The minimum monthly payment is 2.5% of your outstanding balance.

steps.do: Check the Diamond Elite Card: invitation only, credit score of at least 780, minimum payment 3.0%. A customer without an invitation cannot apply for it
steps.quote: Membership is by invitation only (Yes).

steps.do: Check the EcoCard: no credit score requirement, FX fee 1.0%, minimum payment 1.0%, virtual card management Yes, annual fee $50.00
steps.quote: Minimum credit score required to apply: 0 (0 indicates no credit score requirement).

steps.do: Check the Crypto-Cash Back card: FX fee 0%, minimum payment 1.5%, virtual card management Yes, annual fee $75.00, minimum credit score 660
steps.quote: What is the minimum credit score to apply for the card to earn crypto rewards? $660.

steps.do: Remove cards the customer cannot get. Gold Rewards needs Rho-Bank+ and a score of at least 720. Platinum needs 750. Silver needs 680. Crypto-Cash Back needs 660. Bronze needs 640. EcoCard has no score minimum. Diamond Elite is by invitation only (score about 780 or higher). With a stated score below 640, only EcoCard remains.
steps.quote: Minimum credit score: $680

steps.do: Among the cards left by filter_eligible, keep only those that meet every hard feature requirement the customer stated. Use the documented values. Foreign transaction fee: Bronze 2.75%; Silver 2.75% without Rho-Bank+ and 0% with it; Gold 0%; Platinum 0%; Diamond Elite 0%; EcoCard 1.0%; Crypto-Cash Back 0%. Minimum payment: Bronze 1.0%; Silver 1.5%; Gold 2.0%; Platinum 2.5%; Diamond Elite 3.0%; EcoCard 1.0%; Crypto-Cash Back 1.5%. Virtual card management: Bronze No; Silver No; Gold, Platinum, Diamond Elite, EcoCard and Crypto-Cash Back Yes. A value equal to the customer's ceiling meets it ('or lower').
steps.if: the customer stated hard feature requirements (foreign transaction fee ceiling, minimum payment ceiling, virtual card management or another documented term)
steps.quote: Foreign transaction fee without a premium subscription: 2.75%

steps.do: Compare all personal cards: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond Elite, Crypto-Cash Back and EcoCard. If filter_requirements ran, compare only the cards that passed it. For each card, use its earn rate on the customer's actual spending, its effective annual fee (fee minus any rebate) and its eligibility. Earn rates: Bronze 1.0%; Silver 4.0% on travel/software and 1.0% otherwise; Gold 2.5%; Crypto-Cash Back 2.0%; Platinum 10.0%; Diamond Elite 5.0%; EcoCard 5 points/$ on green and 1 point/$ otherwise ($0.01 per point). Platinum's $200.00 fee nets to $50 if at least $7500.00 is spent in every month. Do not count bonus categories already covered by another card, such as travel paid by a corporate card. Drop ineligible cards and cards whose fee the customer will not accept. Then pick the highest earn rate left.
steps.quote: Purchases in non-bonus categories earn the card’s default rate.

steps.do: Apply the customer's fee preference. Annual fees: Bronze $0.00, Silver $0.00, Gold $0.00, EcoCard $50.00, Crypto-Cash Back $75.00, Platinum $200.00, Diamond Elite $495.00. If the customer refuses annual fees, keep only the eligible $0.00 cards. Consider a fee card only if the customer accepts fees or no eligible fee-free card remains.
steps.quote: Consider your net rewards after the $200.00 annual fee when planning large purchases.

steps.do: Recommend the card or cards that passed filter_requirements, with each card's documented terms: minimum credit score, annual fee, APR, foreign transaction fee, minimum payment and virtual card management. If exactly one card passed, recommend it. If several passed, choose among them with the branch steps below, which consider only cards that passed. If nothing separates them, present them all and let the customer choose. Tell the customer they can apply themselves.
steps.if: the customer stated hard feature requirements and at least one card passed filter_requirements
steps.quote: Virtual card management features are available: Yes.

steps.do: Recommend the Gold Rewards Card and explain it: 2.5% cash back on all purchases, $0.00 annual fee, Rho-Bank+ required, minimum score 720, 0% foreign transaction fee.
steps.if: the customer has Rho-Bank+ and a score of at least 720; they want no annual fee, or Gold gives the highest net return within their fee budget; and, if filter_requirements ran, Gold passed it
steps.quote: Cash back on all purchases: 2.5%

steps.do: Recommend the Silver Rewards Card if a meaningful share of the customer's own spending is travel or software and their score is at least 680. Otherwise, explain that both Silver and Bronze earn 1.0% on everyday spending, and recommend Bronze if the score is below 680.
steps.if: Gold is not eligible (no Rho-Bank+ or score below 720), the customer wants no annual fee, and, if filter_requirements ran, the recommended card passed it
steps.quote: You earn 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases.

steps.do: Recommend exactly one card: the Platinum Rewards Card. Explain the 10.0% cash back, the $200.00 annual fee, the $150.00 rebate when the threshold is met in all 12 monthly windows, and the minimum credit score of $750.
steps.if: expected monthly spend >= $7500.00, $200.00 - $150.00 is within the customer's fee budget, the score is at least 750, and, if filter_requirements ran, Platinum passed it
steps.quote: A single month below the threshold disqualifies you from receiving the rebate for that entire cardmember year; there is no partial or prorated rebate.

steps.do: Recommend exactly one card, the Platinum Rewards Card, even if the customer asks for a list of options. Explain three things: it earns 10.0% cash back on all purchases; the $200.00 annual fee is reduced by a $150.00 rebate when at least $7500.00 posts in every monthly window of the cardmember year, so the effective fee is $50; and Rho-Bank+ is not required. Tell the customer that approval needs a minimum credit score of 750. The agent cannot check the score, so do not drop the card because the score is unknown.
steps.if: expected monthly spend >= $7500.00, an effective fee of $50 is within the customer's fee budget, the customer has no Diamond Elite invitation, the customer has not given a credit score (does not know it or declines to say), and, if filter_requirements ran, Platinum passed it
steps.quote: Minimum credit score required: $750.

steps.do: Recommend the eligible fee card with the highest net cash back on the customer's spending, and state its fee clearly. Platinum: 10% for $200.00, with a $150.00 rebate only if $7500.00 is spent in every month. Diamond Elite: 5% for $495.00, invitation only. Crypto-Cash Back: 2% for $75.00. EcoCard: $50.00.
steps.if: either the customer accepts an annual fee (the card's fee fits their budget) but recommend_one does not apply, or no eligible fee-free card exists; and, if filter_requirements ran, the card passed it
steps.quote: You earn 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases.

steps.do: Recommend the highest-earning eligible card that fits the budget: Gold at 2.5% if the customer has Rho-Bank+, otherwise the card with the next highest flat rate. If no card fits, say so.
steps.if: Platinum's effective fee exceeds the customer's budget (considering only cards that passed filter_requirements, if it ran)
steps.quote: Rho‑Bank+ premium subscription required: Yes

steps.do: Present the card chosen in the branch steps above and explain why: its earn rate, its annual fee, any requirement such as Rho-Bank+, and any hard requirement it meets (foreign transaction fee, minimum payment, virtual card management). Recommend only cards that meet every hard requirement and every eligibility rule (credit score, subscription, invitation). Give only public product terms. If the customer rejects every card that fits, say so and do not push.
steps.quote: Cash back on all purchases: 2.5%

steps.do: Tell the customer plainly that no card meets their requirements. If they ask, say which requirement each near-miss card fails. Do not invent exceptions or waivers, and do not push an ineligible card or one they rejected. End politely if they choose to go elsewhere.
steps.if: no eligible card meets the customer's stated requirements
steps.quote: Membership is by invitation only (Yes).

steps.do: If the customer's main goal is a sign-up bonus, ask for whichever of these they have not stated. Is the card personal or business (card_use)? Is the bonus they want points, cash back or a statement credit (signup_bonus_priority)? If more than one card qualifies, how should one be chosen (signup_tie_break, for example the lowest annual fee)? Also ask whether they hold a Diamond Elite invitation. Do not verify identity, because no customer records are read.
steps.if: the customer asks for the card with the best sign-up, welcome or promotional bonus
steps.quote: - Spend $5,000 in eligible purchases within your first month to earn $2,000 sustainability points.

steps.do: Read every personal card's new-customer promotion document: Silver Rewards _009 and _010, EcoCard _009 and _010, Bronze Rewards _008, Platinum Rewards _009, Diamond Elite _009. The Gold Rewards and Crypto-Cash Back documents show no new-customer promotion. If the customer is open to a business card, also read Business Bronze _010 and _006, Business Silver _011 and _012, Business Platinum _011, and Silver Zoom _010 and _012. Never judge from one card's page.

steps.if: the customer asks for the card with the best sign-up, welcome or promotional bonus
steps.quote: Earn a statement credit of $500 when you spend $2,000 in the first 1 month(s) after account opening

steps.do: Sort each promotion read in signup_read_promos by type. Sign-up bonuses (a lump sum of points, cash back or a statement credit for meeting a spend threshold): Silver Rewards $500 statement credit; EcoCard bonus sustainability points; Diamond Elite $5,000 credit plus fee waiver (invitation only); Business Bronze $500 statement credit. Not sign-up bonuses: 0% intro APR (Bronze, Silver, EcoCard, Silver Zoom fuel), first-year annual fee waivers (Platinum, Business Silver, Business Platinum), and cash back multipliers (Business Silver 2x, Silver Zoom 3x). When the customer asked for a points or cash back sign-up bonus, keep only the sign-up bonuses.
steps.if: the customer asks for the card with the best sign-up, welcome or promotional bonus
steps.quote: New customers receive a 0% APR on carried balances for the first 12 months from account opening.

steps.do: Keep only the bonuses whose window includes today's date from check_promo_dates. Windows: Silver Rewards $500 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-30; EcoCard points 2025-08-01 through 2025-12-15; Diamond Elite 2025-11-01 to 2026-01-31; Business Bronze $500 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31. A bonus whose window has ended or has not started is not available. Never present it as available.
steps.if: the customer asks for the card with the best sign-up, welcome or promotional bonus
steps.quote: You must open your account during the promotional period to qualify

steps.do: From the bonuses left by signup_window, drop: the Diamond Elite offer unless the customer has an invitation; business cards if the customer wants a personal card; cards the customer has ruled out. Tell the customer each remaining card's minimum credit score as an underwriting requirement. The agent cannot check the score, and EcoCard has none.
steps.if: the customer asks for the card with the best sign-up, welcome or promotional bonus
steps.quote: Membership is by invitation only (Yes).

steps.do: Tell the customer that no card currently has an open sign-up bonus that fits their request. Briefly say why: the window has closed, the card is invitation-only, or the open promotion is an intro APR or fee waiver rather than a bonus. Do not invent an offer or extend a closed window. End politely if the customer chooses to go elsewhere.
steps.if: no sign-up bonus is left after signup_window and signup_eligibility
steps.quote: The waiver cannot be retroactively applied to accounts opened outside the promo window.

steps.do: For each card left after signup_eligibility, report: the bonus exactly as the document states it, the spend threshold, the qualifying period, the window end date and the annual fee. Personal annual fees: EcoCard $50.00, Silver $0.00, Diamond Elite $495.00 (waived if the offer is met). If more than one card is left, apply signup_tie_break (for example, the lowest annual fee first) and recommend that card. Example: an EcoCard in its window earns $2,000 sustainability points for $5,000 of eligible spend in the first 1 month; the points post after the qualifying period closes. Say the bonus is earned only by meeting the spend in time. Do not promise approval.
steps.if: at least one sign-up bonus is left after signup_eligibility
steps.quote: Spend at least $5,000 in eligible purchases within your first 1 month of account opening.

steps.do: Only if the customer is open to a business card and today is within 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31, add the Business Bronze Rewards Card offer: a $500 statement credit for $10,000 in net purchases in the first 2 months, with a $0.00 annual fee. Say that it is a business card and needs business information. If the customer wants it, continue with the business card job recommend_business_credit_card_for_large_purchase_and_apply.
steps.if: the customer asks for a sign-up bonus, says they are open to a business card, and the Business Bronze offer window includes today
steps.quote: This offer is available from 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31.

done_when: The agent has the facts the decision needs: use, spending categories, any hard feature requirements (foreign transaction fee, minimum payment, virtual card management), fee tolerance or budget, Rho-Bank+ status, credit score (or that the customer did not give it), and monthly spend where Platinum is in play. It has checked all personal cards' rates, fees, features and eligibility. It has then either recommended the card or cards that meet every requirement, with their rate, annual fee and requirements (including any rebate condition and minimum score), or told the customer no card fits. For a customer whose goal is a sign-up bonus, the agent has checked every card's promotion window against get_current_time. It has then either reported each open sign-up bonus that fits (bonus as stated, spend threshold, period, window and annual fee) and recommended one by the customer's tie-break, or said that none fits and why. The customer has applied with apply_for_credit_card, or has declined or chosen to go elsewhere. When the customer named a card, one of two things is true: they applied for it with their full name, annual income and Rho-Bank+ status and were told the result; or they were told it is not available to them (Diamond Elite without an invitation, Gold without Rho-Bank+).
